system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## Project Kestrel — Buyer review

**Overall recommendation: reject the Seller’s package as drafted.** The 20% cap and 18-month general claims period are conditional fallbacks, not authorised positions. Tax and IP terms remain open. References to DD documents below describe the supplied record, not independent verification.

| Issue | Seller’s position | Buyer should want | Recommendation and reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001: General liability cap** | 20% of price: **AUD 4.8m**. | 25%: **AUD 6m**. | **Counter at 25%.** The 20% fallback requires Amelia Frost’s prior written authority identifying the draft; none has been given. |
| **SPA-N-002: De minimis & basket** | Claims must exceed **AUD 25,000** individually and **AUD 250,000** in aggregate; only the excess is recoverable. | **AUD 5,000** de minimis and **AUD 50,000** aggregate basket, with liability from the first dollar once exceeded. | **Reject and replace.** The proposed thresholds and excess-only basket materially reduce recovery. |
| **SPA-N-003: General claims time limit** | Notice within **18 months** after Completion; limitations apply to all claims unless expressly excepted. | **24 months** for general warranty claims, without a blanket override of other categories. | **Counter at 24 months.** The 18-month fallback requires Amelia Frost’s written approval, which has not been given. |
| **SPA-N-004: Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties subject to the general cap and time limits. | Separate regime: **100% cap**, at least **six years**, outside the general basket, de minimis and knowledge bar. | **Reject.** Fundamental ownership and capacity risks require separate protection. |
| **SPA-N-005: Fraud carve-out** | Limitations, exclusive remedies and non-reliance apply to claims of any nature. | Carve out **fraud, wilful concealment and deliberate misconduct** from all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies and non-reliance, to the maximum extent enforceable. | **Insist on an express, comprehensive carve-out.** This protection cannot be waived under the playbook. |
| **SPA-N-006: Disclosure scope** | Deemed disclosure of the entire indexed data room, Accounts, registers and public records. | **Specific fair disclosure** against the relevant warranties; no whole-data-room, public-register or prudent-search deemed disclosure. | **Delete the general disclosures.** Bulk disclosure can obscure matters without fairly identifying the relevant risk. |
| **SPA-N-007: Buyer knowledge qualifier** | Bars matters known to Buyer or advisers, including matters discoverable in the data room or public records. | Delete the blanket bar; any permissible knowledge qualifier should use named Seller knowledge persons and reasonable enquiry, and never excuse title, capacity, fraud or a specific indemnity. | **Reject and redraft.** Discoverability is not a suitable substitute for fair disclosure or a basis to defeat protected claims. |
| **SPA-N-008: Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; condition treated as satisfied upon delivery of written consent. No final consent or evidence of conditions satisfied is included. | **Effective consent and evidence that its conditions are satisfied before Completion.** | **Make both mandatory Completion conditions.** Bluefen represents approximately AUD 3.6m, or 30%, of FY26 revenue; delivery alone may not establish effectiveness. |
| **SPA-N-009: Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m outstanding; security release after Completion. No repayment or final discharge included. | Current payout statement, **direct repayment from Completion funds** and effective security releases. | **Require a documented payout and release mechanism at Completion.** A post-Completion release requires an irrevocable undertaking **and** Amelia Frost’s approval. |
| **SPA-N-010: Employee bonuses** | Conditional **AUD 420,000** bonuses omitted as a separate funds-flow item; applicable on-costs are unstated. | Specific funds-flow line item or Seller funding for the bonuses **plus triggered on-costs**. | **Correct the funds flow and verify payroll tax, superannuation and other on-costs.** The current flow does not transparently fund the conditional liability. |
| **SPA-N-011: Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; DD-010 records **AUD 180,000 open**, but payment status is not independently verified. | Broader indemnity addressing the Ironquay IP risk, while preserving the **SOW3 cure**; obtain payment evidence and confirmatory assignment as appropriate. | **Broaden the indemnity and investigate.** Transfer is conditioned on cleared payment of every SOW3 fee, and neither payment nor non-payment is independently established. |
| **SPA-N-012: Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary operational matter said not to be expected to be material. | Preserve logs and evidence, investigate access and scope, and require updates and assessment of any notification or remediation obligations. | **Require an investigation and reporting covenant.** The record establishes neither access, breach, harm, notification duty nor a loss amount. |
| **SPA-N-013: Sandbar renewals** | Treats the three renewals, totalling **AUD 330,000**, as ordinary-course costs. | Assess each renewal’s timing, scope, accrual, avoidability and termination rights. | **Investigate before allocating.** Do not automatically classify the amount as Debt or deduct it from price; the supplied record also does not establish that it is ordinary course. |
| **SPA-N-014: Category separation** | General limitations apply to all claims unless expressly stated otherwise. | Separate, explicit treatment of **Title, Tax, IP, payment and covenant** categories, without a hidden general-regime override. | **Delete the global override and reconcile cross-references.** Otherwise a general limitation may silently defeat a separately negotiated protection. |
| **SPA-N-015: Title verification** | Relies on the DD-012 Company share register showing Seller as holder of 100%. | Independent evidence of title, ownership, encumbrances and authority, in addition to reviewing DD-012. | **Obtain independent verification before Completion.** DD-012 is a supplied internal source, not independent proof. |
| **SPA-N-016: Tax/IP open terms** | Says Tax and IP warranty positions are settled under the general regime. | Keep Tax and IP terms **open**, separately negotiated and expressly coordinated with applicable limitations and remedies. | **Reject the assertion of settlement.** No resolution or unlimited liability should be assumed. |

The disclosure also identifies an **office lease notification**, not a stated consent requirement, and a **Mossvale assignment restriction**, not a stated consent requirement merely because shares are sold. Confirm their operation without assuming either is a share-sale consent condition.
=== END ADVICE ===
